decisions.reason: The DPA management software builds on the firm's documented compliance know-how and agency focus, and early customer feedback praising its nearly 200 agency templates shows the firm can read and learn from results, so it fits the signalled expansion of compliance capabilities.

As the flagship management platform shown on the home page, it rests directly on the firm's integrated management tools and containerized architecture, the core knowledge base it is expanding for agencies.
A configurable managed hosting plan is a close extension of the firm's owned infrastructure and hosting expertise, so it is easy to interpret, refine and absorb into the established business.
